# Renewable Energy Utilization Analytics - RStudio project

NIET Greater Noida, BTech CSE-DS, Foundation of Data Science (CCSDS0301)
Student: Purva Arora (2501331540208)

**Data note:** the dataset is SYNTHETIC. It is generated by `R/00_generate_synthetic_data.R`
(seeded, so reproducible) and is not official or real-world energy data. Countries are generic
labels (Country A to Country J).

## How to run (RStudio)
1. Open `RenewableEnergy.Rproj` (working directory = project root).
2. `source("R/00_generate_synthetic_data.R")` - writes `data/raw/renewable_energy_synthetic_dataset.csv`
3. `source("R/analysis.R")` - cleans the data, computes statistics, saves tables and the five figures.
Base R only; no packages to install. To analyse a different dataset, put exactly one CSV with the same six
columns in `data/raw/` (see `data/raw/README.md`) and run step 3 only.

## Contents
- `R/` - the two scripts
- `data/raw/` - synthetic input dataset (400 records, 8 missing consumption values)
- `data/processed/cleaned_dataset.csv` - after group-median imputation
- `outputs/tables/` - descriptive statistics, totals by year/source/country, outliers, correlation matrix
- `outputs/figures/` - the five charts used in the report
- `outputs/key_results.txt` - every figure quoted in the report, plus R session info
- `report/` - the final report (DOCX and PDF)

## Status
Both scripts were run in R 4.3.3 (Linux sandbox) to produce the files included here, and the report numbers
were checked against them. They have not yet been run on your own computer in RStudio. Re-running should
reproduce the same dataset and numbers (seeded; R 3.6 or later); if anything differs, use your local output
and update the report.
